title: Fix three bugs in a Rust key-value cache with TTL
description: A simple KV cache with expiry has three bugs: insert stores wrong expiry, get checks expiry with wrong comparison, and evict_expired removes live entries instead of expired ones.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/lib.rs:
1. `insert`: change `Instant::now()` to `Instant::now() + ttl` so the expiry is in the future
2. `get`: change `if Instant::now() > *expiry` to `if Instant::now() < *expiry` (return value only when entry is still live)
3. `evict_expired`: change `retain(|_, (_, expiry)| now > *expiry)` to `retain(|_, (_, expiry)| now <= *expiry)` to keep live entries
All 3 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test --quiet` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
